editorial:
Imagine you are caught between a scary drug boss and a cop who is just as dangerous. That is exactly where you find yourself in this high-stakes game of cat and mouse. You follow a low-level dealer who loses everything and decides to flip on his bosses to get revenge. He teams up with a reckless undercover officer who cares more about catching the big boss than following the rules. The vibe is intense and gritty, making you feel like you are right in the middle of the dirty streets of Seoul. It is a wild ride where nobody is who they seem to be, and the tension keeps building until you are on the edge of your seat.

What really makes this work is the acting and the constant twists that keep you guessing. The action scenes are punchy, and the pacing is fast enough that you will not get bored. While some of the plot points are a bit wild, the excitement makes up for it. If you love crime dramas with big surprises, you need to see this. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the gritty details. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move because the colors and sound really pop.
endingExplained: You find out that the mysterious boss, Mr. Lee, was actually a fake identity. The real mastermind was the guy who seemed like a side character all along. After a big showdown, the undercover cop finally catches the true villain. The movie ends with a final twist showing that the cycle of crime continues, as the power just shifts to a new person who is ready to take over the drug empire.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime thrillers and big plot twists.
